idea: Two coworkers argue over who forgot to submit the quarterly report, and it turns out neither of them did.

characters.name: Jade
characters.description: A sharp, no-nonsense project lead in her thirties: warm brown skin, long straight black hair parted to one side, big green eyes, teal diamond earrings, a charcoal blazer over an emerald blouse; quick to anger when someone goes behind her back.

characters.name: Ron
characters.description: A silver-haired executive in his sixties with bushy grey brows, steel-blue eyes, a navy suit and red tie; smug, unhurried and used to getting his way.
